releaseNotes: Added atomic withdrawal and refund request processing that deducts the member balance safely.
Added debit entries to member wallet transaction history for completed withdrawal requests.
Linked withdrawal tickets to the corresponding wallet transaction for status tracking.
Added optional event details when creating organization events, with details shown when an event is opened.
Added clickable event details dialogs for calendar events and holidays.
Standardized the admin display name as John Paul Bugayong across member status views.
Improved interaction responsiveness by deferring heavier chat, meeting, and Jitsi initialization until after navigation updates paint.
Removed obsolete ticket synchronization and ticket submission diagnostic console logging while preserving real sync errors.
Updated Admin and member-facing display labels from Admin to John Paul Bugayong without changing internal email-based identity handling.
Removed the optional Details input from admin and member event forms.
Added organization-scoped data isolation across admin and member workflows.
Added organization selection and quick organization creation during admin startup.
Blocked deleted member accounts from re-entering through saved sessions or Firebase Auth.
Displayed maintenance mode before members select an organization.
Applied maintenance state immediately for restricted members during startup.
Fixed mobile keyboard background glitches on the login and index pages without pausing the animated background.
Prevented the animated auth background from intercepting typing and touch input.
Prevented shared animated body layers from bleeding through auth cards during mobile keyboard resize.
Matched chat date separator and sent-time digits to the standard text font instead of emoji-style rendering.
Matched the member maintenance overlay design to the organization selection maintenance screen.
Scoped member removal to the active organization and preserved credentials for members in other organizations.
Standardized admin and member sessions on Firebase Anonymous Auth.
Blocked orphaned member credentials from login and account listings when they are not associated with an active organization.
Allowed anonymous-auth member removal and account cleanup through Firestore rules.
Refined chat date separators and sent-time typography with a text-only design.
Restored the legacy maintenance mode flow with the old background, Ticket History, and Submit Ticket sections.
Applied the requested maintenance page design with its large artwork, responsive typography, and light/dark global background.
Added optional custom chat-room names for rooms created by admins and members, with automatic names preserved when left blank.
Renamed visible My Collab Progress Report headings to Progress Report and synchronized the corrected assets for Android and iOS.
Changed the standalone My Space page to show a Coming Soon message while the feature remains under development.
Improved My Space startup by rendering core organization data before loading chat history.
Prevented redundant initial realtime refreshes while preserving live updates for every organization the member belongs to.
Scoped My Space data and realtime subscriptions to the member's active organizations.
